text:
maria: Heads up — two tenants report NDJSON exports missing chunks. manifest says 10, download has 7.

sam: any manifest id or logs?

maria: mf-2026-03-21-11. logs show queue drop reason=DroppedMessageQuota around 11:02:
```
queue: drop export=mf-2026-03-21-11 reason=DroppedMessageQuota topic=export-topic-7
```

ops-bot: ALERT export-queue-delay topic=export-topic-7 avg=52s :warning: 

jun: quick check — we changed routing policy yesterday and demoted export-topic-7 to background. background routes use eviction_policy=oldest so spikes evict in-flight chunks.

sam: telemetry we need asap: export.request.chunks_expected, export.chunks.delivered, export.topic.evictions. alert when delivered/expected < 0.95.

lee: UX: console should show status badge: complete / partial / failed with tooltip "expected 10 • delivered 7 • reason: DroppedMessageQuota" and a CTA "request re-export".

irina: compliance: partial exports are not acceptable without SOC flagging. legal wants automatic SOC ticket + tenant+manifest snapshot.

maria: i'll add chunks_expected/chunks_delivered and mark export state=incomplete when mismatch. will open PR today.

jun: i'll roll back the routing change for compliance-labelled topics and switch eviction_policy to block for them. pushing now (est 1h).

sam: i'll add dashboards + alert + webhook for delivery receipts (6h). will also add synthetic verifier to periodically download and verify manifests.

lee: i'll prototype badge and POST /api/exports/:id/retry for re-export flow.

ops-bot: DEPLOY started by jun -> routing-config change rc-1203

maria: tagging affected customers and prepping runbook.

irina: filing SOC playbook for partial export alerts.

sam: good — making export health first-class is the right call. anyone else?

jun: will post rollback logs when finished.

maria: closing for now — will update PR/runbook link here.
